name: Target Mastercard

base_rate.description: 1% on purchases everywhere else outside of Target.

categories.label: Target stores and Target.com (5% off at checkout)

rewards.redemption_notes: The 5% saving at Target is applied instantly at checkout. The product page does not state how the 2% and 1% earnings outside Target are paid out.

notes: Issued by TD Bank, USA, N.A. Applicants are considered for the Target Mastercard first and, if they do not qualify, for the Target Circle Credit Card. Benefits shared by Target Circle Cards include 5% off at Target, 30 extra days for returns, free standard shipping on Target.com and 50% off a Target Circle 360 membership. APRs are not stated on the product page. No Mastercard network package is stated, so network_tier is none.
